sessionStart.powershell: $r = $env:COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT; if (-not $r) { $r = $env:PLUGIN_ROOT }; if (-not $r) { $r = $env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT }; $s = if ($r) { Join-Path (Join-Path $r 'scripts') 'register-dispatch-companion.ps1' } else { $null }; if ($s -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $s -PathType Leaf)) { & $s } else { [Console]::Out.Write('{}') }
